title: Dan-Gun

symbol.name: Dan-Gun
symbol.meaning: The founder of Korea · ITF pattern 2 of 24

note.p: Dan-Gun is named after the holy Dangun, the legendary founder of Korea in 2333 BC. The diagram is I: two bars joined by a stem. You start in the middle of the A–B bar facing D, block and punch to B and A, drive four steps down the stem to D, turn 270° for twin forearm blocks and punches to E and F on the far bar, rise back up the stem toward C with four rising blocks, then turn 270° again for knife-hand strikes and punches to B and A. Every punch in the pattern is a high punch.

footer: Move numbers follow the ITF Encyclopedia count (21 movements, one technique each; 13 and 14 flow together). Directions use the ITF letters: you start facing D, with B on your left and A on your right; E and F are the ends of the far bar. Finish by bringing the left foot back to parallel ready stance.

moves.desc: Stand at the centre of the A–B line facing D in parallel ready stance: feet parallel and one shoulder-width apart, fists in front of the belt.
Turn left: move the left foot to B into a right L-stance facing B (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Knife-hand middle guarding block.
Step the right foot forward toward B into a right walking stance. Right high punch.
Turn clockwise: move the right foot to A into a left L-stance facing A (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Knife-hand middle guarding block.
Step the left foot forward toward A into a left walking stance. Left high punch.
Turn left: move the left foot to D into a left walking stance facing D. Left forearm low block.
Step the right foot forward toward D into a right walking stance. Right high punch.
Step the left foot forward toward D into a left walking stance. Left high punch.
Step the right foot forward toward D into a right walking stance. Right high punch, with a kihap.
Turn 270° to the left: move the left foot round to E into a right L-stance facing E (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Twin forearm block.
Step the right foot forward toward E into a right walking stance. Right high punch.
Turn clockwise: move the right foot to F into a left L-stance facing F (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Twin forearm block.
Step the left foot forward toward F into a left walking stance. Left high punch.
Turn left: move the left foot to C into a left walking stance facing C. Left forearm low block.
In the same stance, left forearm rising block, flowing straight on from the low block.
Step the right foot forward toward C into a right walking stance with a right forearm rising block.
Step the left foot forward toward C into a left walking stance with a left forearm rising block.
Step the right foot forward toward C into a right walking stance with a right forearm rising block, with a kihap.
Turn 270° to the left: move the left foot round to B into a right L-stance facing B (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Left knife-hand middle outward strike.
Step the right foot forward toward B into a right walking stance. Right high punch.
Turn clockwise: move the right foot to A into a left L-stance facing A (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Right knife-hand middle outward strike.
Step the left foot forward toward A into a left walking stance. Left high punch.
